Both games were develop by High Moon Studios and publish by Activision. Both games are also third person shooters. War for Cybertron came out in 2010 while Fall of Cybertron came out in 2012. I got both games $10 a piece on Ebay, they retail on avg. $10-15 anywhere else.

Both games follow the 1980's cartoon of Transformers with War for Cybertron being about the civil war between the Autobots and Decepticons, while Fall of Cybertron is about the Autobots trying to leave Cybertron. A big plus with both games is that they have many of the voice actors from the cartoons.

Gameplay wise is the same in both games you have your main fire arm and your secondary weapon which is a lot stronger with no ammo, in both games you have the ability to transform into a ground vehicle or flying vehicle depending on the Transformer your using, even the controller schemes are the same in both game. Both games also have the same style of campaigns where you have 12 missions half Autobots and the other half Decepticons main difference between the two game is in War for Cybertron has three Transformers to chose from in each mission giving you a chance to play as all of the main cast at least once time, while Fall of Cybertron lets you have no choice as who your playing as. However, your companion A.I. is very good and actually fights good.

Overall I like both games though liked War for Cybertron better due to the selections and a longer single player game which is 9hrs compared to about 6hrs. My other main dislike is Fall of Cybertron has a lot of micro-transactions in the single player game for extra weapons. I give War for Cybertron 8/10 and Fall of Cybertron 7/10, both games are fun cheap games to play through specially if your a Transformers fan.

Note: I never did try to check to see if either games online multiplayer are still working.
Selection in Disguise: Transformers War for Cybertron/ Fall of Cybertron
